summary: A DFM window shows unsaved changes only when an edit really changed something, and no longer asks to discard changes that were undone.
details: After each edit the window compares its values, selections, and notes with the last loaded or saved state; the unsaved-changes marker shows only when they differ, so a click that changes nothing never shows it.
When later edits bring the window back to its saved state, the marker clears, Save is disabled again, and closing asks nothing.
Opening or refreshing a method still never marks it as edited.
